args.prompt: Three big hits on the beat: the three kids on the car hood are hype men; on each hit they punch their fists into the air together and shout 'FAST!', bouncing on the hood; on the last hit the kid with the skateboard hoists it overhead; the camera bumps on each hit. Three kids sit on the hood of a boxy 80s sedan under the overpass at dusk, graffiti on the pillars, sodium light. Camera: Medium, three-quarter angle, fisheye edge distortion. 1990s hand-painted cel anime, dusk under a highway overpass, sodium light, film grain, VHS softness. Keep the art style, characters, faces, hair, outfits and any lettering exactly as in the first frame. No new text or subtitles.
args.negative_prompt: 3D render, CGI, photorealistic, morphing, warped faces, extra limbs, extra people, subtitles, captions, watermark, text changes, new writing, changing letters or numbers, slow motion
